usage: cox lake sync [-h] [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR] [--profile PROFILE] [--dry-run] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR
  --profile PROFILE    the routing profile naming the provider profile (default: ~/.config/agent-
                       tools/profile.yaml or $AGENT_TOOLS_PROFILE)
  --dry-run            report what would be synced; create and write nothing
  --json
